snippet.title: Gears of Glory - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Gears of Glory is a Tower Defense game centered around driving a van, where the player pilots the vehicle to collect Gears used to build powerful towers and stop robots from destroying their bases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450120

Voice Over: Fernando Foster
